questions.q: How does the Datalogic Magellan trigger compared with the Zebra DS9308 at the till?
o: Datalogic's proximity sensor triggers as you approach; the Zebra needs a deliberate present-and-hold
questions.e: Bench-test point 1: Datalogic's sensitive proximity sensor triggers as you approach, while the Zebra typically needs present-and-hold.

questions.q: How do you change settings on a Datalogic Magellan at the counter?
o: On the device — hold 2 sec for volume, 4 sec for factory reset
It cannot be reconfigured once deployed
questions.e: Bench-test point 3: Datalogic configures on-device. Zebra requires the 123Scan Windows utility, admin rights and a USB cable.

questions.q: What is the default carriage-return behaviour out of the box?
o: Off on Datalogic, on with Zebra
On with Datalogic; every Zebra customer asks how to enable it
questions.e: Bench-test point 4: Datalogic ships with carriage return enabled by default; Zebra customers routinely have to ask how to turn it on.
